pw.title: Policies
pw.sub: Short, clear pages customers read before they order. Numbers come from Rules, so they always match checkout.
pw.note: Your own words only: nothing is written for you. A page with no words stays a draft and does not show on the shop.
pw.previewHelp: This is how the page reads on the shop. A blank line starts a new paragraph, “## ” starts a heading and “- ” starts a list line.
pw.sharedNote: The shop already had this page. Its words are the same ones as in Settings › Policies & texts, so a change there shows here as a new version.
pw.published: Published — the shop shows it now
pw.restored: Version {v} brought back as a new draft
pw.unsaved: You have changes that are not saved. Leave anyway?
pw.readOnly: You can look at these pages. Changing them needs the settings permission.
pw.historyHelp: Every version is kept. Restoring one makes a new draft; nothing is ever removed.
pw.noHistory: No versions yet. Save a draft to start the history.

err.INVALID_INPUT: Check the words: fill both English and Bengali for each box you use, and write the page text before publishing
err.STALE: Someone else changed this page. Reload and try again
err.PLACEHOLDER: Replace the stand-in text in square brackets with the real words
err.UNKNOWN_TOKEN: A rule number in the words does not match any rule
err.NO_DRAFT: There is no draft to publish
err.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this

glance.title: At a glance
glance.note: These numbers are read from your Delivery settings, so this page always matches checkout. Change them there.

sec.title: Sections
sec.help: One short point per line. Starter text stays as it is until you save a change.

terms.title: Orders
points: An order is confirmed when we call or send an SMS.
Photos are real; colour may look slightly different on screens.

terms.title: Prices
points: Prices may change; your order keeps the price you saw.

privacy.title: What we collect
points: Name, phone, address and order history to deliver your parcels.
details: Couriers get only what they need to deliver.

privacy.title: Offers
points: We send offers only if you said yes. Reply STOP to stop.

delivery.title: How long it takes
points: Inside Dhaka, the Dhaka suburbs and outside Dhaka each have their own time; the cards above show it.
details: Friday and public holidays may add one day.

delivery.title: Trial at the door
points: Open the parcel and check it in front of the rider.
Do not like it? Return it and pay only the delivery charge.
details: Partial delivery is allowed: keep some pieces, return the rest.

delivery.title: Tracking
points: SMS with a tracking link when the courier takes the parcel.

exchange.title: Wrong size: exchange
points: Ask within the exchange hours after delivery.
Unworn, unwashed, with tags.
An exchange delivery charge applies.
details: Caps and extras cannot be exchanged.

exchange.title: Defective or wrong item: we send it again
points: Tell us within the exchange hours, with a photo.
We collect it and send you the right product again, free, no charge at all.
Same for prepaid orders.
details: These are replaced with the right product, not refunded or added to the wallet.

exchange.title: What you can pick (size exchange)
points: Same product in another size, then another colour, then the same category.
Higher price: pay the difference on delivery.
Lower price: the rest goes to your wallet after the old piece is checked.

exchange.title: Sending the old piece
points: Hand it to the rider who brings the new one, within the days we tell you.

payment.title: Ways to pay
points: Cash to the rider, bKash, Nagad or card.
Prepaid orders are confirmed faster.

payment.title: When we ask for advance
points: Big first orders or past refused parcels: delivery charge first.

cancellation.title: Cancelling
points: Cancel free any time before the parcel goes to the courier.
After that, refuse at the door and pay only the delivery charge.

cancellation.title: Money back
points: Paid in advance and the order is cancelled before dispatch (by you or by us): the full amount goes back to the same bKash, Nagad or card.

cancellation.title: After delivery
points: No refunds after delivery.
Wrong size: exchange within the exchange hours.
Defective or wrong item: we send the right product again, free.

wallet.title: Wallet
points: Leftover from a lower-price exchange goes here.
Use it on your next order; it cannot be cashed out.

wallet.title: Coupons
points: One coupon per order. Each coupon shows its minimum order and end date.

reviews.title: How reviews work
points: Only customers with a delivered order can review.
We never delete negative reviews.
Spam or abusive words are hidden, with the reason shown.

cookies.title: Why we use cookies
points: To keep your bag and login.
To see which pages help people shop.
details: You can turn ad cookies off from the banner at any time.

pw.guide: Delivery fees, free-delivery limit, COD limit, advance rule and exchange hours are read from Rules. Change them there and every page updates by itself.
pw.allWords: Edit all words, title and preview
